steps.title: Follow the musical path
steps.caption: We will keep one project through this course, changing one musical decision at a time.

steps.title: Locate the controls
steps.caption: You can identify each control before operating it.

steps.title: Open Device
steps.caption: Device opens for channel 1.

steps.title: Apply one output
steps.caption: The selected output becomes active. Selecting a draft alone does not apply it.

steps.title: Set the tempo
steps.caption: The project uses 90 BPM. With ClockMod /1, each channel step lasts one sixth of a second.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Enter four attacks
steps.caption: Four active attacks light on row 4.

steps.title: Assign and shorten
steps.caption: Pattern 1 feeds channel 1 across a four-step range.

steps.title: Give the attacks a pitch and level
steps.caption: All four attacks share pitch, velocity and duration.

steps.title: Play and stop
steps.caption: Four equal C notes repeat. Playback stops with notes released.

scenes.title: 4. Spread the rhythm across a bar

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Extend the range
steps.caption: The channel traverses16 steps before repeating.

steps.title: Move the attacks
steps.caption: Four attacks now sit on the four beats. The old attacks have been removed explicitly.

steps.title: Hear the longer phrase
steps.caption: C–C–C–C remains the pitch sequence; the space between attacks has increased.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Find the channel default
steps.caption: C3 (MIDI 60) is the common pitch.

steps.title: Select the last beat
steps.caption: The screen now describes step 13.

steps.title: Raise the last note
steps.caption: Only step 13 receives the note exception.

steps.title: Return to the default view
steps.caption: The screen returns to C3; step 13 retains D3.

steps.title: Compare the ending
steps.caption: C–C–C–D replaces C–C–C–C at the same attack positions.

steps.title: Reduce the final emphasis
steps.caption: The last D is quieter; pitch and timing stay the same.

steps.title: Masks default g
steps.caption: Compare the setting or phrase before continuing in the same project.

steps.title: Compare a changed default
steps.caption: G–G–G–D demonstrates that an exception survives a changed default. C–C–C–D is restored.

steps.title: Remove both exceptions
steps.caption: C–C–C–C at velocity 80 returns. K2 cleared both Note and Vel, not only the selected field.

steps.title: Keep the answering note
steps.caption: The outgoing phrase is C–C–C–D, final velocity 50.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Enter two bass notes
steps.caption: Pattern 2 supplies a root and fifth.

steps.title: Route channel2
steps.caption: The bass uses MIDI 48 and55 in the default C-major scale. Both channels repeat in16 steps.

steps.title: Hear the two parts
steps.caption: C–C–C–D sounds above a C–G bass pulse. Both parts retain independent settings.

steps.title: Sequence composition merge skip
steps.caption: Compare the setting or phrase before continuing in the same project.

steps.title: Sequence composition merge all
steps.caption: Compare the setting or phrase before continuing in the same project.

steps.title: Compare overlapping rhythms
steps.caption: Skip removes overlapping attacks 1 and9, leaving5 and13. All restores the four attacks. The existing Note 60 default and step 13Note62 exception keep the pitch comparison fixed. Unassigning pattern 2 returns the original phrase; CH02 keeps its bass pattern.

scenes.title: 7. Change harmony without changing the rhythm

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Restore note inheritance
steps.caption: All Note exceptions are cleared. K2 also cleared the velocity exception, which is deliberately restored.

steps.title: Retain the same melody in the pattern
steps.caption: C–C–C–D returns through relative notes. The quieter ending stays in the channel mask.

steps.title: Prepare a second scale
steps.caption: Hear C–C–C–D and bass C–G before editing the second scale.

steps.title: Harmony design draft scale
steps.caption: Root D and Major are prepared in slot 2. Press K3 before using the grid.

steps.title: Harmony design apply d
steps.caption: After K3, the same rhythm becomes D–D–D–E with bass D–A.

steps.title: Compare the transposition
steps.caption: The phrase becomes D–D–D–E and bass D–A. Rhythm and velocity are preserved. C major is restored for the arrangement.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Add the late attack
steps.caption: A C pickup falls halfway between the last beat and the next bar.

steps.title: Reduce the pickup level
steps.caption: The pickup is quieter than the main beats and the D ending. Probability and parameter slides are optional follow-up guides; this version remains deterministic.

setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.title: Copy the complete section
steps.caption: Slot 2 stores the same phrase, bass and channel settings.

steps.title: Song composition sparse muted
steps.caption: Compare the setting or phrase before continuing in the same project.

steps.title: Make the first section sparse
steps.caption: Slot 1 contains bass only; slot 2 adds the upper phrase and pickup.

steps.title: Set slot 1 to one bar
steps.caption: Song slot 1 shows Global length 16. Its section lasts one 16-step bar when Repeats is 1.

steps.title: Song composition length slot1
steps.caption: Compare the setting or phrase before continuing in the same project.

steps.title: Set slot 2 to one bar
steps.caption: Song slot 2 shows Global length 16. Its section lasts one 16-step bar when Repeats is 1.

steps.title: Song composition length slot2
steps.caption: Compare the setting or phrase before continuing in the same project.

steps.title: Set the section boundary
steps.caption: Both slots show Global length 16 and Repeats 1. Song mode is On: each section lasts one 16-step bar.

steps.title: Hear the arrangement
steps.caption: Bass alone → bass and phrase → bass alone → bass and phrase. The highlighted Song slot changes at each boundary.

steps.caption: The named project stores the two-section arrangement.

steps.title: Keep your work temporary edit
steps.caption: Compare the setting or phrase before continuing in the same project.

steps.title: Prove the saved version
steps.caption: Slot 1 returns to bass alone; the temporary change is removed.

steps.title: Keep your work loaded files
steps.caption: Compare the setting or phrase before continuing in the same project.

steps.title: Replay the restored sections
steps.caption: The saved bass-only/full-phrase alternation is restored. Continue with merge, recording or modulation task guides without replacing this saved version.
